declienting: Removed the Sitecore Content SDK Link wrapper, the LinkField prop, the editing-mode branching, and resolveSitecoreLiveLinkPlan. The library takes a resolved href; link-field resolution stays in the project.
Removed the next/link import and the eight forwarded Next-specific props in favour of a polymorphic `as`, so the component is not Next-only.
Replaced the ExternalLinkIcon import with startIcon and endIcon slots.
Moved the animated underline into src/lib/underline.ts so Breadcrumbs can share it without importing from another component.
Replaced hard-coded 48/40/36px touch targets with --size-touch-* tokens, so the WCAG 2.5.8 floor is raised in one place.
Dropped the five card-specific underline exports (event card, podcast card, search-result card); those are project compositions, not link behaviour.
Kept verbatim: the background-size underline with box-decoration-break clone, its motion-reduce path, the touch-target pseudo-element technique, and aria-disabled semantics.
